headline: Mooring County Flares as Weathered Expanse Holds Hot
war_summary: Since the last edition Mooring County has quickened to eleven Warden and one Colonial with six changes in two hours and twenty on the day centred on Gravekeeper's Holdfast and Wiccwalk, day losses running 5,941 Colonial and 5,254 Warden on accelerating hourly rates; the Weathered Expanse now stands five Warden, one Colonial and three unheld with two changes in two hours and fifty on the day about Wightwalk, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, day losses 8,627 Colonial and 11,410 Warden as hourly rates cool. The Nevish Line at five Warden to three Colonial has gone quiet in two hours after five changes in six and twenty-one on the day about Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way, day losses 4,169 Colonial and 5,042 Warden. Palantine Berm, seven Warden, is also quiet in two hours after five in six and thirty on the day about The Droll and The Pippeli Stones. Callahan's Passage at nine Warden to one Colonial remains quiet in six hours after nineteen changes on the day about Crumbling Post, while Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row show no changes in six hours.
